_note: BUG-648: the report summary's 'Criteria needing your judgment' block (screen 4h). Two counts that mean different things: criteria with no accepted grade (escalated, the instructor must grade them) and automatic grades kept with a caution or a later note (the instructor should check them before relying on them). Never say nothing is waiting while a row asks to be checked. Counts are row counts, not judgments.
heading: Criteria needing your judgment
grade_none: No criterion needs a grade from you.
grade_one: 1 criterion needs a grade from you.
grade_many: {count} criteria need a grade from you.
grade_hint_one: It has no accepted grade yet. Grade it in manuscript review, beside the manuscript.
grade_hint_many: These have no accepted grade yet. Grade them in manuscript review, beside the manuscript.
check_none: No automatic grade asks you to check it first.
check_one: 1 automatic grade asks you to check it before relying on it.
check_many: {count} automatic grades ask you to check them before relying on them.
check_hint_one: Its card in Criterion records says what to check.
check_hint_many: Each card in Criterion records says what to check.
none_title: No criterion needs a grade from you
none_body: Every criterion has a recorded grade or assessment limit, and no automatic grade asks you to check it first.
kpi_link_label: Automatic grades to check first: {count}. Go to the list.
